name: LeBron James
steps: Full speed from the top, shoulders square.
The help defender bounces off. He doesn't.
Shoulders rolled forward and down, fists low. Flex.
aria: Original illustration of LeBron James' power drive: he goes downhill at full speed, runs through a help defender, throws down a two-hand dunk and finishes with his shoulder-roll flex. Not traced from footage, not to scale.
